priorityList: Summon your pet if you have the Unbreakable Bond talent.
Cast Aimed Shot as your primary opener before entering combat.
Use Volley on cooldown to trigger Sentinel's Symphony and other hero talent effects.
Use Trueshot on cooldown, ideally immediately following a Volley cast.
Activate offensive Racials (like Berserking or Blood Fury) and on-use Trinkets while Trueshot is active.
Use your Combat Potion during Trueshot, especially if Bloodlust is active or the fight is ending.
Cast Rapid Fire if the Unload talent is active and the target is below 20% health or you have low stacks of Bulletstorm.
Cast Arcane Shot to spend Precise Shots procs.
Cast Aimed Shot if you are about to cap at 2 charges or if the target has Sentinel's Mark applied.
Avoid casting Aimed Shot if Volley is coming off cooldown in less than 2 seconds, unless Trueshot is active.
Cast Rapid Fire on cooldown to generate Focus.
Cast Steady Shot as a filler when you have no other available abilities and need to generate Focus.
